thread:
Nina H: Opening docs PR #5110 to add quantized and long-context lines to the nebula6b model card. Current card only lists fp16 numbers and a broken bench link. I want to add q8_0 + q4_0 rows, two SDK snippets (Go + Rust) and a short migration note for pinned tags.

Evan C: Thanks Nina. Bench runs (internal) attached: https://bench.internal/redwood/nebula6b-quant-2026. Quick summary for seq512 on A100-40: nebula6b-q4_0 peak w/ KV cache ~4.0GB, w/o KV ~5.2GB. nebula6b-q8_0 peak w/ KV ~4.6GB, w/o KV ~5.8GB. Long-context fp16 variant (seq1024) ~9.1GB.

Evan C: Inline mini-table for the card:

```
Model                   seq512   w/KV-cache   w/o-KV
nebula6b-q4_0           4.0GB     4.0GB        5.2GB
nebula6b-q8_0           4.6GB     4.6GB        5.8GB
nebula6b-long-fp16      9.1GB     9.1GB        11.0GB
```

Ravi K: Nice. For variety, can we add Go and Rust SDK snippets instead of repeating Python? Many infra teams use Go and we have a small Rust SDK example internally. Also add a CLI snippet showing `--kv-cache` and `--quant` flags.

Nina H: Good call. Draft Go snippet (to include in docs):

```go
// go example
client := redwood.NewClient(nil)
resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{
  Model: "nebula6b-q4_0",
  Options: map[string]any{"kv_cache": true, "fallback": []string{"nebula6b-fp16"}},
  MaxTokens: 128,
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

Nina H: Draft Rust snippet: 

```rust
// rust example (docs)
let client = Redwood::new();
let resp = client.generate(GenerateRequest::new("nebula6b-q4_0").kv_cache(true).fallback(vec!["nebula6b-fp16"]).max_tokens(128)).await?;
println!("{}", resp.text);
```

Ravi K: Small notes: use "KV cache" capitalization; in the Go snippet prefer `Options: map[string]interface{}` and in Rust mention that async runtime is required. Also add a one-line migration blurb: "If you pinned `nebula6b:latest`, pin `nebula6b@v2` or explicitly request `nebula6b-q4_0` to opt into quantized variants."

Evan C: Also add the usual caveat: "Numbers are approximate and can vary by driver, runtime, sequence length, batch size, and KV cache usage." And call out that Hosted routing may route to a compatible fp16 variant while Dedicated/Private honor explicit `fallback` order.

Nina H: Pushed updates to PR: table, Go+Rust snippets, CLI example, migration note, and the bench link fix. Marked @Evan C and @Ravi K as reviewers. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5110
